title: An order's inputs
description: The inputs an order carries for the tuples that require them, as the operator states them when intake opens the order (T-020-46): the body of a statement kept in the evidence store behind the salted commitment order_opened names, so a Core that reopens reads them back and the log holds no account (REQ-AUD-6). It names no transaction and is appended about nothing.

inputs.description: Each input, by name: never empty, since an order with no input states none.
